Repeats now drop. A key that already delivered within 5 minutes is skipped.

A dropped repeat does not restart the clock. Only real deliveries do.

I read "in the last 5 minutes" as including the 5-minute mark. So a repeat at exactly 5 minutes drops. Say the word if you want it to send.

The replay drops 99 of 900, no errors. `verify.js` passes too, so all four rules line up.
